pe_path.rule: PE must connect input to output without relay/fuse/thermal cutoff.

relay_contacts_separate.note: NO contacts must be separate nets before/after switching.

relay_coil_selv.note: Relay module inputs are driven from SELV GPIO through the carrier MOSFET; J3 pins 3/4 are tied on the PCB.

pzem_isolation.note: No net may short PZEM mains terminals to its TTL side. PZEM internal optocouplers are the barrier.

mains_selv_separation.note: Static net check only; does not prove PCB/enclosure creepage.

limitations: Board revision is unverified; static compare only.
Engineering BOM is unpriced; bom/BOM_PROCUREMENT.csv is a dated listing matrix, not a supplier quote.
